scope: Complete invented positions and provider frames; actual current handlers and model, all I/O mocked; no private or provider reads.

portfolio_summary.pnl_scope: Rows with eligible quantity, mark and cost basis only; unrealized price P&L before fees, income and FX
portfolio_summary.accounting_assumptions: Legacy single-currency cash-equity arithmetic; instrument, currency and account reconciliation unverified

permissions.reason: Price-risk observations and hypothetical shocks do not establish forecast edge or account suitability

risk_contract.scope: USD cash equities/ETFs; current signed quantities, multiplier 1; no options/FX
risk_contract.currency_basis: Legacy snapshot Polygon US-stock marks are USD; explicit other currencies rejected
risk_contract.return_basis: Split-adjusted daily price returns; dividends, financing, fees and liquidity losses excluded
risk_contract.alignment: Matching interval endpoints on observed SPY sessions; one common sample
risk_contract.model: Normal zero-mean 1-day delta-normal VaR; not maximum possible loss or a calibrated tail guarantee
risk_contract.netting: Duplicate symbol lots summed; gross exposure sums absolute lots

errors: capital book reconciled_at missing, stale or future
drawdown requires two reconciled NAV observations from this book

AAA.drawdown_basis: 30/90 observed sessions; split-adjusted price, not account drawdown

BBB.drawdown_basis: 30/90 observed sessions; split-adjusted price, not account drawdown

risk.concentration_basis: Absolute marked lot exposure / gross marked exposure; not NAV and not ETF look-through
